subject: Mutual WinPlan Kickoff — OrionX evaluation and benchmark scope
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Patel <samira.p@orionx.com>, Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@orionx.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual WinPlan Kickoff — OrionX evaluation and benchmark scope

Hi Samira / Michael,

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, we put together a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to align on the evaluation scope, success criteria, and who's owning what across the POC. Attaching the editable MAP template and a short benchmark plan for tokens/latency that our infra team will run during the POC.

High-level goals (proposal):
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency <= 650ms for 512-token completions, embedding recall >= 0.92 vs current Lucene baseline, cost-per-1000 tokens <= $0.65 with suggested quantization.
- Benchmark plan: three phases — baseline run (current infra), Redwood-optimized run (caching, batching), and end-to-end app test (integration + production-like load). We recommend a 2-week baseline + 2-week Redwood run.
- Deliverables: benchmark report, prompt-eval suite (50 prompts), and a runbook for rollback/fallback.

Proposed owners (Redwood):
- Technical lead / infra bench runs: Jonas Weber (jonas.weber@redwood.ai) — sets up stress harness and KV cache configs.
- Prompt/eval owner: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.ai) — will coordinate prompt collection and scoring rubric.
- Commercial / timelines: me — Markus Klein — will coordinate milestones and procurement touchpoints.
- Support / onboarding: Vanessa Ortiz — console access and token analytics.

Asks for OrionX: please confirm
- Primary evaluation stakeholders (who will validate success criteria)
- Any compliance or network constraints for private endpoints
- Target close timeline (we proposed a 30–45 day evaluation + procurement window)

I attached: OrionX_MAP_Template_v1.xlsx (editable MAP), redwood_benchmark-plan_v0.3.pdf (bench plan).

Suggested times for a 45-minute MAP kickoff this week:
- Tue Oct 6 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue Oct 6 15:00–16:00 PT
- Wed Oct 7 09:00–09:45 PT

If those don't work, propose alternatives and we'll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to locking the owners and timeline so we can start the bench runs.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Thanks Markus — this is great and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick notes from OrionX: 

1) Stakeholders: I'll be the technical owner from the product side, Michael (cc'd) will lead commercial and procurement. Please also include Jenny Liu (product QA) on prompt/accuracy sign-off — I've cc'd her.
2) Compliance check: we're in the middle of a SOC 2 refresh; we need to confirm retention and logging settings before any private endpoint work. Is there a short security checklist you can share?
3) Timeline: target go/no-go demo to execs by Nov 20; procurement would need firm numbers by Nov 1 to make budget. So your 30–45 day evaluation is ok but we need the benchmark run to complete by Oct 28 to meet our internal dates.

We can take Tue Oct 6 10:00 PT. Forwarding to procurement for any contracting constraints.

Thanks,
Samira
Director, Product Engineering | OrionX
samira.p@orionx.com

Hi Samira — great to meet you virtually. Quick follow-up items from our side and proposed owner-level activities to keep to your Oct 28 benchmark completion ask: 

Owner map and near-term deliverables:
- Prompt collection & scoring rubric (owner: Laura Bennett) — I'll send a short template for you to populate with 50 test prompts and labels (intent, expected tokens, pass/fail thresholds) by EOD Wed Oct 7.
- Infra bench harness + smoke tests (owner: Jonas Weber) — Jonas will provision the runner and start a low-throughput baseline on Thu Oct 8; full baseline will run Oct 11–15 unless you prefer earlier.
- Access & analytics (owner: Vanessa Ortiz) — Vanessa will provision console accounts for Samira and Jenny and share an onboarding note.
- Commercial milestone tracker & procurement liaison (owner: Markus Klein) — I'll keep procurement looped.

Proposed compressed schedule to meet Oct 28: 
- Oct 6 — MAP kickoff meeting (45m) — confirm prompt list and access
- Oct 7–10 — prompt collection and rubric finalization
- Oct 11–18 — baseline bench run (your infra)
- Oct 19–25 — Redwood-optimized run + integration test
- Oct 26–28 — results review and exec-ready summary

Attachments I've uploaded to the shared MAP (see Drive link) with a slightly updated timeline. Jonas and I will be at the kickoff to walk through the bench steps.

Meeting: Tue Oct 6 10:00 PT — confirmed. Dial-in details in calendar invite.

Laura Bennett

Quick confirmation: kickoff tomorrow 10:00 PT — Samira, I'll be on the call. Procurement will review the SOW and we may use DocuSign for signature.
